scenes.title: Attention, per head — tfQh, tfKh, tfVh, tfAttnH, tfHeadOut, tfConcat, tfAttnOut
scenes.description: One layer of attention with every head exposed: pick the head, change the head count or share K/V, and read each function's lattice.
scenes.markdown:
This lesson is a **function tour** of the transformer domain library, not a lesson about transformers: every lattice is labelled with the call that fills it, so an author can see what each function returns and how the `tf_*` sliders reshape it. The weights are the hand-built toy at layer 0 / head 0 and **seeded tables everywhere else — nothing here is learned.**

## Attention, per head

| function | shape | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `tfH(0, i, d)` | n × d_model | the input stream x |
| `tfWq(l, h, r, c)`, `tfWk(l, g, r, c)`, `tfWv(l, g, r, c)` | d_model × d_k | projections of head h / K-V head g |
| `tfHeadKv(h)` | — | which K/V head query head h reads: ⌊h·n_kv/n_heads⌋ |
| `tfQh`, `tfKh`, `tfVh (l, h, i, d)` | n × d_k | q, k, v as head h sees them |
| `tfScoreH`, `tfScoreScaledH`, `tfAttnH (l, h, i, j)` | n × n | raw scores, scaled scores, weights |
| `tfHeadOut(l, h, i, d)` | n × d_k | head h's output before W_O |
| `tfConcat(l, i, c)` | n × n_heads·d_k | all heads side by side |
| `tfWo(l, r, c)`, `tfAttnOut(l, i, d)` | · | the projection back to d_model, and the increment |

Drag **head shown** to switch heads; **tf_heads** to 4 gives four heads of d_k = 1 (the concat stays 4 wide); **tf_kv** to 1 makes every head read the same K and V. $W_O$ is a tensor slider bound to its lattice: hover a cell to edit it.
scenes.prompt: A function tour of the general transformer engine, attention part. Every lattice is labelled with the domain call that fills it. Weights beyond layer 0 / head 0 are seeded, not learned; say so if asked what the numbers mean.

steps.title: Attention, per head — tfQh, tfKh, tfVh, tfAttnH, tfHeadOut, tfConcat, tfAttnOut
steps.description: One layer of attention with every head exposed: pick the head, change the head count or share K/V, and read each function's lattice.

add.label: tfH(0, row, col) — the input stream $x$

axes.title: tfH(0, row, col) — the input stream $x$

add.prompt: tfH(l, i, d): component d of the residual stream entering layer l at slot i. Layer 0 is x: embedding plus positional encoding.

add.valueExpr: (col < tfDk() and demo_h < tfHeads()) ? (tfWq(0, demo_h, row, col)) : 0
add.label: tfWq(0, h, row, col)
add.prompt: W_Q of layer 0, head demo_h. Head 0 is the hand-built toy; other heads are seeded tables. Every W is read by tfWq/tfWk/tfWv with (layer, head, row, col).

add.valueExpr: (col < tfDk() and demo_h < tfHeads()) ? (tfWk(0, tfHeadKv(demo_h), row, col)) : 0
add.label: tfWk(0, tfHeadKv(h), row, col)
add.prompt: W_K of the K/V head that query head demo_h reads: tfHeadKv(h) = floor(h · n_kv / n_heads). With tf_kv = 1 every head reads the same one.

add.valueExpr: (col < tfDk() and demo_h < tfHeads()) ? (tfWv(0, tfHeadKv(demo_h), row, col)) : 0
add.label: tfWv(0, tfHeadKv(h), row, col)
add.prompt: W_V of the K/V head that query head demo_h reads.

add.valueExpr: (col < tfDk() and demo_h < tfHeads()) ? (tfQh(0, demo_h, row, col)) : 0
add.label: tfQh(0, h, row, col)
add.prompt: q of every slot in layer 0, head demo_h (RoPE applied when s2_rope = 1).

add.valueExpr: (col < tfDk() and demo_h < tfHeads()) ? (tfKh(0, demo_h, row, col)) : 0
add.label: tfKh(0, h, row, col)
add.prompt: k as read by head demo_h: its K/V head's keys.

add.valueExpr: (col < tfDk() and demo_h < tfHeads()) ? (tfVh(0, demo_h, row, col)) : 0
add.label: tfVh(0, h, row, col)
add.prompt: v as read by head demo_h. Never rotated by RoPE.

add.label: tfScoreScaledH(0, h, i, j)
add.prompt: Scaled scores of head demo_h: tfScoreH / (sqrt d_k)^s3_scale. tfScoreH gives the raw dot products.

add.label: tfAttnH(0, h, i, j)
add.prompt: Attention weights of head demo_h, honouring s3_scale, s3_mask and s3_maskafter. Rows sum to 1.

add.valueExpr: (col < tfDk() and demo_h < tfHeads()) ? (tfHeadOut(0, demo_h, row, col)) : 0
add.label: tfHeadOut(0, h, row, col)
add.prompt: Head demo_h's own output before concatenation and W_O: the attention-weighted average of its value rows.

add.label: tfConcat(0, row, c) — all heads side by side

axes.title: tfConcat(0, row, c) — all heads side by side

add.prompt: The concatenated heads of layer 0, n_heads × d_k wide; column c belongs to head floor(c / d_k). What W_O multiplies.

add.label: tfWo(0, row, col)
add.prompt: W_O of layer 0 (n_heads·d_k × d_model). Bound to the tensor slider tf_wo_0: hover a cell to edit it.

add.label: row $i$ of the scaled scores, head $h$
add.prompt: The scaled scores of query slot demo_i against every key, for the head shown. The mask has not been applied: masked keys still have a score.

add.label: row $i$ of the attention weights, head $h$
add.prompt: Softmax of the scaled-score row with the causal mask applied: masked keys are 0, the rest sum to 1.

add.label: tfAttnOut(0, row, col) — the increment
add.prompt: The attention sub-layer's increment to the stream: concat × W_O, back at d_model width. Multi-head does not widen the stream.

info.title: The configuration in force
info.content: n = {{tfN()}} tokens · $d_{\text{model}}$ = {{tfDModel()}} · $d_k$ = {{tfDk()}} · heads = {{tfHeads()}} · K/V heads = {{tfKv()}} · layers = {{tfLayers()}} · $d_{ff}$ = {{tfDff()}} · vocabulary = {{tfVocabN()}} words\n\nK/V cache = {{tfKvCache()}} numbers (2 · n · n_kv · d_k per layer) — sharing saves ×{{tfKvSaving()}}. Head 0 reads K/V head {{tfHeadKv(0)}}, head 1 reads {{tfHeadKv(1)}}, head 3 reads {{tfHeadKv(3)}}.

scenes.title: The block — tfAttnIn, tfResid1, tfFfIn, tfFfPre, tfFfHidden, tfFfOut, tfResid2
scenes.description: The residual stream through one layer: attention increment, FFN increment, and where the norms sit.
scenes.markdown:
This lesson is a **function tour** of the transformer domain library, not a lesson about transformers: every lattice is labelled with the call that fills it, so an author can see what each function returns and how the `tf_*` sliders reshape it. The weights are the hand-built toy at layer 0 / head 0 and **seeded tables everywhere else — nothing here is learned.**

## The block

| function | meaning |
|---|---|
| `tfH(l, i, d)` | stream entering layer l |
| `tfAttnIn(l, i, d)` | what attention reads (normed under pre-norm) |
| `tfAttnOut(l, i, d)` | the attention increment |
| `tfResid1(l, i, d)` | after the first residual add |
| `tfFfIn(l, i, d)` | what the FFN reads |
| `tfFfPre(l, i, k)`, `tfFfHidden(l, i, k)` | hidden units before / after the activation |
| `tfW1(l, r, c)`, `tfW2(l, r, c)` | the FFN weights |
| `tfFfOut(l, i, d)` | the FFN increment |
| `tfResid2(l, i, d)` | stream leaving layer l (= tfH(l+1)) |

Switch **tf_norm** between none, LayerNorm and RMSNorm and **tf_prenorm** between pre and post; the card checks the residual identity and the row mean live. **tf_act** changes what happens between `tfFfPre` and `tfFfHidden`.
scenes.prompt: A function tour of the general transformer engine, block part: the residual stream through one layer. The card checks the residual identity and the norm means live.

steps.title: The block — tfAttnIn, tfResid1, tfFfIn, tfFfPre, tfFfHidden, tfFfOut, tfResid2
steps.description: The residual stream through one layer: attention increment, FFN increment, and where the norms sit.

add.label: tfH(l, row, col) — stream in
add.prompt: The residual stream entering layer demo_l.

add.label: tfAttnIn(l, row, col)
add.prompt: What attention reads: with tf_norm on and tf_prenorm = 1 this is the normed stream; otherwise the stream itself.

add.label: tfAttnOut(l, row, col)
add.prompt: The attention increment (all heads, through W_O).

add.label: tfResid1(l, row, col)
add.prompt: Stream after the attention residual add (post-norm: after its norm).

add.label: tfFfIn(l, row, col)
add.prompt: What the FFN reads: normed (pre-norm) or tfResid1 itself.

add.label: tfFfPre(l, row, k) — before the activation

axes.title: tfFfPre(l, row, k) — before the activation

add.prompt: FFN hidden units before the activation: tfFfIn · W1. Row k of W1 is one neuron's fan-in.

add.label: tfFfHidden(l, row, k) — after the activation

axes.title: tfFfHidden(l, row, k) — after the activation

add.prompt: After the activation chosen by tf_act: ReLU zeroes the negatives, GELU bends them, SwiGLU gates silu(x W1) by x W3.

add.label: tfFfOut(l, row, col)
add.prompt: The FFN increment: hidden · W2, back at d_model width.

add.label: tfResid2(l, row, col) — stream out
add.prompt: The stream leaving layer demo_l = tfH(demo_l + 1). Pre-norm: exactly stream in + both increments.

add.label: FFN hidden units at slot $i$: before and after the activation
add.prompt: The eight hidden units of slot demo_i in layer demo_l, before (orange) and after (yellow) the activation. ReLU: the yellow point sits on the orange one when positive and at 0 otherwise; GELU bends the negatives; SwiGLU multiplies by a gate, so yellow can leave the orange entirely.

add.label: tfW1(l, row, col)
add.prompt: FFN W1 of layer demo_l (d_model × d_ff). Layer 0 is bound to tf_w1_0: hover a cell to edit.

add.label: tfW2(l, row, col)
add.prompt: FFN W2 of layer demo_l (d_ff × d_model).

info.title: The residual identity at slot 2
info.content: pre-norm: out − (in + attention + FFN) = ({{toFixed(tfResid2(demo_l,2,0) - tfH(demo_l,2,0) - tfAttnOut(demo_l,2,0) - tfFfOut(demo_l,2,0), 6)}}, {{toFixed(tfResid2(demo_l,2,1) - tfH(demo_l,2,1) - tfAttnOut(demo_l,2,1) - tfFfOut(demo_l,2,1), 6)}}, …) — zero while tf_prenorm = 1; post-norm normalises the sums, so it is not.\n\nMean of tfAttnIn row 2 = {{toFixed(tfAttnIn(demo_l,2,0)+tfAttnIn(demo_l,2,1)+tfAttnIn(demo_l,2,2)+tfAttnIn(demo_l,2,3), 4)}} — zero under LayerNorm, not under RMSNorm (no mean subtraction).

scenes.title: Stack and sample — tfH by depth, tfFinal, tfWu, tfLogit, tfProb, tfArgmax, tfEntropy
scenes.description: The stream at every depth, the unembedding, and the next-token distribution under temperature.
scenes.markdown:
This lesson is a **function tour** of the transformer domain library, not a lesson about transformers: every lattice is labelled with the call that fills it, so an author can see what each function returns and how the `tf_*` sliders reshape it. The weights are the hand-built toy at layer 0 / head 0 and **seeded tables everywhere else — nothing here is learned.**

## Stack and sample

| function | meaning |
|---|---|
| `tfH(l, i, d)` for l = 0 … tf_layers | the stream at every depth |
| `tfFinal(i, d)` | what the unembedding reads |
| `tfWu(v, d)` | the tied unembedding: embedding row of word v |
| `tfLogit(i, v)` | score of word v at slot i |
| `tfProb(i, v)` | softmax(logits / tf_temp) |
| `tfArgmax(i)`, `tfVocabToken(v)` | the most probable next word |
| `tfEntropy(i)` | how spread the distribution is |

Drag **tf_temp** towards 0.05 and every row of `tfProb` collapses onto its argmax; towards 5 and it flattens to 0.2 each. Add layers with **tf_layers** and watch the stream drift with depth.
scenes.prompt: A function tour of the general transformer engine, sampling part. Emphasise that tfProb at slot i is the prediction for the token AFTER i, and that the argmax words are an artefact of seeded weights.

steps.title: Stack and sample — tfH by depth, tfFinal, tfWu, tfLogit, tfProb, tfArgmax, tfEntropy
steps.description: The stream at every depth, the unembedding, and the next-token distribution under temperature.

add.label: tfH(0) — enters layer 0
add.prompt: The stream entering layer 0 (x).

add.label: tfH(1) — leaves layer 0
add.prompt: The stream after one layer.

add.label: tfH(2) — leaves layer 1
add.prompt: After two layers (with tf_layers < 2 this repeats the last stream: indices clamp).

add.label: tfH(3) — leaves layer 2
add.prompt: After three layers.

add.label: tfFinal(row, col) — what the unembedding reads

axes.title: tfFinal(row, col) — what the unembedding reads

add.prompt: The final norm of the stream leaving the stack (pre-norm), or that stream itself.

add.label: tfWu(v, d) — the tied unembedding
add.prompt: Row v is the embedding row of vocabulary word v. Logits are dot products against these.

add.label: tfLogit(i, v)
add.prompt: Score of word v at slot i: tfFinal(i,·) · tfWu(v,·), before temperature.

add.label: tfProb(i, v) — softmax(logits / tf_temp)
add.prompt: The next-token distribution at slot i, for the token after slot i (causal). Rows sum to 1. tf_temp → 0 gives argmax, → ∞ gives uniform.

add.label: tfVocabToken(tfArgmax(i))
add.prompt: The most probable next word at each slot (tfArgmax) and its probability (the cell value).

add.label: tfEntropy(i) in bits
add.prompt: Shannon entropy of the slot-i distribution: 0 at T → 0, log2(5) = 2.32 at T → ∞.

add.label: logits at slot $i$
add.prompt: The five logits at slot demo_i: tfFinal(i,·) dot each word's embedding row. Temperature does not touch these.

add.label: the distribution at slot $i$ = softmax(logits / tf_temp)
add.prompt: The same five words as probabilities. Drag tf_temp towards 0.05 and the argmax takes everything; towards 5 and every word tends to 0.2.

add.label: entropy of every slot's distribution
add.prompt: How spread each slot's next-token distribution is, in bits: 0 when one word has all the mass, log2(5) = 2.32 when the five are equal. All six slots move together with tf_temp.

info.title: Slot {{demo_i}} predicts the next token
info.content: argmax = word {{tfArgmax(demo_i)}} with p = {{toFixed(tfProb(demo_i, tfArgmax(demo_i)), 3)}} · entropy {{toFixed(tfEntropy(demo_i), 3)}} bits · row sum {{toFixed(tfProb(demo_i,0)+tfProb(demo_i,1)+tfProb(demo_i,2)+tfProb(demo_i,3)+tfProb(demo_i,4), 6)}}
